method.game_selection: First 20 games per opponent; all outcomes, no candidate-output selection. At plies 12/24/36/48/64/80, clamped to len-2; deduplicate full FEN within a game. Include a stronger-reference first reply from every root.
method.teacher: Pinned Stockfish, one thread, Hash64, Skill20, limit strength off, fresh hash, 50000 nodes per FEN-only query, preserve score-bearing iterations and use last completed exact score. Strong response and finite labels, not ground truth.
method.splits: Group by first four opening UCI moves. Sorted 10 public families: first six train, next two validation, last two holdout. Keep paired root/reply and all games of each family in same split; drop cross-family duplicate board identities from fitting, retain raw.
method.fit: Additive 12 feature × middle/end weights, fixed material and existing placement. Nonnegative bounded weights on advantage-oriented features; ridge shrinkage to zero. Choose regularization on validation only; unlock holdout once after freezing selected integer weights. CP-only, nonchecked positions; exclude mate labels, claimable draws and halfmove>60 from fitting but preserve raw. Fit residual clipped to ±400 cp, require both teacher and base within ±1500 cp, deduplicate board identity across all splits (retain raw excluded rows). Regularization grid 0.001/0.01/0.1/1/10; no intercept; select on validation clipped MAE after integer rounding. Runtime gate: combined static cost at most 1.75x baseline, zero feature allocations.
method.gate: Feature/runtime budget first; independent feature controls and symmetry; held-out clipped CP MAE must improve at least 5% with no greater-than-10% increase in catastrophic residuals. Then actual search decision/equal-time checks before games. No named root-move forcing or Stockfish-only success condition.
method.search: Unchanged v0.17 search, quiescence, tables, clocks, material values and base placement. No bishop-pair or rejected piece-safety term.
method.no_automatic_actions: No live games, larger confirmation, commit, push or next PR.
